voice: Upbeat, quick, friendly male coach, brisk pace, energetic, no long pauses.
music: Upbeat light electronic instrumental for a quick fitness explainer, punchy drums, bright synth plucks, 124 BPM, about 20 seconds, clean ending, stays quiet under a voice.

script.intro: Sitting all day? Your hips are stealing your height.
script.outro: Thirty seconds each side, every day.

sections.name: Hip flexors
sections.say: Tight hip flexors tilt your pelvis forward. This lunge stretch opens them up.

clips.shot: Full body side view, kneeling hip flexor stretch on a black mat: one knee down, the other foot forward, hips pushed gently forward, torso tall, arms overhead; the front of the hip of the back leg glows. Figure in the lower-middle of the frame
clips.move: a kneeling hip flexor stretch, hips easing forward and back while the torso stays tall

clips.shot: Low front 3/4 view, kneeling lunge stretch, torso upright, arms reaching overhead; the hip flexor of the back leg glows intensely
clips.move: a kneeling lunge stretch, reaching higher overhead on each slow breath
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right
